security_spec.violation_condition: QEMU TCG implements the RV64-only pair word instructions (PPAIREO.W, PPAIROE.W, PPAIRO.W) without gating on XLEN=64. On RV32, TCG would reference bits [63:32] of the guest register state, which exceed the 32-bit register width. The TCG temp or register storage may contain stale host-level data beyond the intended 32-bit boundary, leaking it into the guest-visible rd result.
security_spec.vulnerability_pattern: XLEN/32 loop bound or 64-bit bit-slice extraction in TCG op helpers for P-ext pair operations without mstatus_mxl or xlen runtime guard, specifically word-suffix (.W) pair ops not checking `get_xl(ctx) == MXL_RV32` or equivalent before indexing sX[63:32]
security_spec.summary: RV64-only pair word instructions (PPAIREO.W/PPAIROE.W/PPAIRO.W) read bits 63:32 of source registers; if QEMU TCG exposes these on RV32, the TCG implementation accesses register state beyond XLEN=32, potentially leaking host data into the guest rd result
